answer_1.quote: Sequential neural network architectures in their various forms have become the mainstay in abstractive summarization.

answer_2.quote: Automatic Evaluation. We evaluate the quality of summaries through ROUGE F-1 scores ... by counting the unigram (R-1), bigram (R-2) and longest common subsequence (R-L) overlaps. ... we also use BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluations. We also invited human referees from Amazon Mechanical Turk to assess our model ...
answer_4.guideline: We ask the referees to choose the best and worst summaries from the four candidates for each criterion. ... three criteria: i) Relevance (Whether the conveyed information in the candidate summary is relevant to the article?), ii) Informativeness (How accurate and faithful information does the candidate summary convey?), and iii) Redundancy (Whether the sentences in each candidate summary are non-redundant with each other?).
